Hint 1: In 4-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$4$$ equal parts. Each part is used as a validation set once while the remaining three parts are used for training. Consider how this process ensures that each data point is used in the validation set.

Hint 2: Think about the purpose of cross-validation. It aims to evaluate the model's performance on different subsets of the data. How does this process ensure that every data point is included in the validation set at least once?
